scope_outcomes.criterion: A retained finding requires a literal passage in which Riley assigns Max Weber a substantive argumentative role in the text.
scope_outcomes.basis: The text explicitly states Riley’s interpretation of Weber’s claim about general laws of history and uses it as a qualified foil in Riley’s argument about the necessity of theorizing historical development.
limitations: The finding concerns only this supplied 2018 citing text and does not represent Riley’s complete work or Weber’s entire reception.
The passage does not identify the specific Weber texts or editions underlying Riley’s formulation.
